source_instructions: Copy one complete code line from the following pages.
Paste it with your image to rebuild the poster in that style.
internal_ids: EP001-EP200 are local lookup identifiers assigned in category order, then top-to-bottom row order; they are not printed individual code IDs or native model controls.

interpretation_provenance.status: design interpretations derived from code labels and existing Skill design principles; not supplied per-code definitions from the PDF

command_scope: Within this explicitly activated Skill or a request that unambiguously names this Skill; catalog browsing itself does not activate design or rendering.
future_extension_policy: Keep the 200 PDF codes and their EP IDs unchanged. Additional authored codes require explicit scope and separate origin attribution; never present them as entries from the PDF.
localization: English is the maintained source language. The Skill translates explanatory prose for the user at response time while preserving canonical code strings and IDs. Catalog aliases do not select a response language.
